Machine-readable form of everything below: [`data/Autograd7Metalens.json`](data/Autograd7Metalens.json). The verdict and the one-line note for this notebook are in the summary table, [`../validation.md`](../validation.md); what the fields here mean is in [`README.md`](README.md).
